Spring.label: Spring
Spring.description: The ice breaks. Rivers swell with snowmelt. Salmon begin their run. Time to plant, gather, and prepare.

Summer.label: Summer
Summer.description: Long days. Berries ripen. The rivers run full and clear. The most productive season.

Fall.label: Fall
Fall.description: The last great harvest. Salmon run again. Store everything you can before the cold comes.

Winter.label: Winter
Winter.description: The cold tests everything. Food and firewood must last. Keep the elders and children warm.
